company.name: 聯詠科技股份有限公司

items.text: Familiar with or interested in HEVC, H.264, MPEG or other video codec standards
Interested in data compression and relevant state-of-the-arts
Experienced in RTL design, IP integration, FPGA verification, or SW/HW co-simulation

description.text:
【產品線描述】
Smart TV Solutions：提供TVSoC、MEMC/FRC及面板相關顯示裝置的控制晶片
ASIC Solutions：提供智能手機、智能電視、電競螢幕、AI Server等產品各種ASIC(包含CoWoS/ChipLet平台)解決方案
【工作說明】
1. Video codec design and development
2. Codec IP integration and verification
【必要條件】
1. Familiar with or interested in HEVC, H.264, MPEG or other video codec standards
2. Interested in data compression and relevant state-of-the-arts
3. Experienced in RTL design, IP integration, FPGA verification, or SW/HW co-simulation
4.Pay attention to teamwork

key_values.label: 科系要求
key_values.text: 電機電子工程相關、資訊工程相關

requirements.text:
工作經歷：不拘
學歷要求：碩士以上
科系要求：電機電子工程相關、資訊工程相關
擅長工具：FPGA、RTL
